meaning:
1) to move, proceed, advance, move on, become old, be removed
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to move
1a2) to advance (in years), grow old and weak
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to move forward, proceed, move on
1b2) to remove
1b3) to transcribe

elsewhere.note: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to…
He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.
My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.
These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.
